title: BearySMP
description: A Modded SMP with bossfights every week.
body:
Welcome to BearySMP! The SMP gets regular updates, unique mods, and exciting events for all players. The server runs on Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge, offering smooth gameplay and custom features.

⚔️ Boss Events every week!

- Special bosses appear on separate servers for epic fights

- Unique kits are provided for each boss fight — ready to use, no preparation needed

 🖥️  Mods & Features

- Modded gameplay with The Aether, Stellarity, Alex's Mobs and way more

- Custom mechanics for armor, mining, and combat enhancements

- Forge-based mods for smooth performance

🌐 Community & Server Info

- Friendly Discord community with events, voting for mods, and boss announcements

- Separate servers for special events to keep your main world safe

- Regular updates with new bosses, mods, and challenges

Join BearySMP to explore, fight bosses, collect unique loot, and become part of a growing modded community! 

More information in our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/VNaxpstSEd).
